a: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
d:
Stephen Colbert learns of a four-times-rejected pitch from writer Michael Cruz Kayne for a song-and-dance number set to the tune of "It's Raining Men." Special thanks to "Late Show with David Letterman" band leader, and writer of "It's Raining Men," the one-and-only Paul Shaffer!
Watch The Late Show with Stephen Colbert weeknights at 11:35 PM ET/10:35 PM CT. Only on CBS.
